ambiguities.detail: Exports map null entries ('./*/index', './internal/*', './cli/internal/*', './cluster/internal/*', './index') are explicitly BLOCKED subpaths: they must resolve to nothing (Unknown/blocked), not fall back to file probing. A resolver that ignores nulls and probes the filesystem would wrongly resolve effect/internal/X.
